messages:
Mia Chen: Hey team, quick heads-up 1. Ib4m planning to be in Warsaw for family reasons from 2026-05-10 through 2026-09-07 but will remain a Redwood employee. Do I need to change my homebase or can I stay listed as US - Remote (SF)? Also curious how the $200/month WFH stipend is handled while abroad. 
Jordan Park: You can raise this here for official sign-off. Short answers: homebase can stay the same for short international stints (policy dependent), stipend usually continues and is prorated monthly, and payroll usually stays US unless you ask for local payroll or bank routing. @Nate can add tax nuance.
Nate Rivera: FYI Poland has a 183-day residency test but 4 months (~120 days) normally wonb4t trigger tax residency. That said, local social security rules or providing services in-country can change things. Keep US payroll to avoid creating a local presence. Share exact dates and whether youb4ll be switching bank accounts.
Mia Chen: Dates are 2026-05-10 to 2026-09-07. Staying on Redwood payroll (W-2), US bank account stays the same. Using company laptop, no local clients.
Sam Ortiz: Thanks. Benefits note: medical coverage from the US plan continues but some local care may be out-of-network. For stays >90 days we usually do a benefits exception review; Ib4ll kick that off. Also need an emergency contact and the temporary remote addendum signed.
Payroll Bot: Note from payroll: "For temporary international remote work under 6 months, US payroll continues unless local law requires registration. Update your temporary address for payroll withholding purposes."
Mia Chen: Temporary Poland address: 
```ul. Jasna 12
00-001 Warszawa
Poland
```
Jordan Park: For the stipend: standard approach is USD monthly payments, prorated by month. If you want PLN routing web4d need to involve our payroll partner and that adds admin work. For equipment: if you want a monitor shipped, Ops Logistics can ship from our EU hub to avoid customs/duties.
Ops Logistics: We can do EU-hub shipments if requested 2 weeks ahead. If we provide equipment upfront, we may offset that value against a monthb4s stipend (web4ll confirm). Shipping personal items from US can be expensive due to customs.
Nate Rivera: One more thing: keeping US payroll avoids establishing nexus. However, if you change declared homebase state (e.g., stop listing CA) we need to update state withholding. If you remain declared SF homebase but are physically in Poland, check your state residency obligations separately.
Mia Chen: Ib4d prefer to keep US homebase and USD stipend. Ib4ll also request the monitor via EU hub. Whatb4s the exact stipend math? $200/month x 4 months?
Sam Ortiz: Yes, $200 x 4 months as long as the temporary remote stint is approved. If you elect equipment from ops, we'll reconcile that value. Ib4ll DM you the temporary remote addendum and emergency contact form.
Security Bot: Reminder: enable 2FA, use company VPN for work, and let security know if you need elevated access from new locations. Geo-logins from Warsaw may trigger a review.
Nate Rivera: Ib4ll document the travel window in the tax review and flag low risk given <183 days. If your dates shift or you take local payments, ping me immediately.
Mia Chen: Thanks all 64964f3fb. Ib4ll sign the addendum and confirm emergency contact. Appreciate the quick responses.
Jordan Park: Great. Web4ll finalize approvals and loop payroll/ops. :white_check_mark:
Sam Ortiz: Starting approvals now. Expect DM + form today.
